disease.title: Disease detection
disease.description: Photograph an affected leaf to identify the disease and see treatment steps.
disease.dropzoneTitle: Take or upload a leaf photo
disease.dropzoneHint: Fill the frame with a single affected leaf, in daylight.
disease.affectedArea: About {pct}% of the leaf area shows symptoms
disease.nearbyDesc: Reports from other fields in An Giang over the past two weeks.

descriptions.leaf_blast: Leaf blast is a fungal disease that spreads fastest in humid weather with heavy nitrogen use. Diamond-shaped lesions with grey centres spread from the lower leaves upward and can cut yield sharply if they reach the panicle.

isolate.title: Isolate the affected block
isolate.body: Avoid walking from the affected block into healthy ones. Spores travel on wet clothing and tools.

fungicide.title: Apply a tricyclazole fungicide
fungicide.body: Spray in the early morning while the leaves are still damp. Repeat after seven days if new lesions appear.

drain.title: Drain the field for two days
drain.body: Lowering humidity in the canopy slows the spread. Re-flood once new lesions stop forming.

timing.title: When to harvest
timing.description: A recommended harvest window based on crop stage, grain moisture, and the rainfall forecast.
timing.windowAria: Recommended harvest window: day {from} to day {to} of March
timing.floodOverlap: Flood risk overlaps the tail of the window
timing.rationale: Grain moisture reaches the 20–22% target around 18 March. Waiting past the 24th risks losing the crop to the forecast flood, and quality drops once the grain over-dries on the stalk.
timing.stageDesc: The crop is in grain filling. The window opens once it reaches maturity.

yield.title: Yield prediction
yield.description: Projected harvest for the current season, with a confidence range that narrows as harvest nears.
yield.trajectoryDesc: Solid line is what has been observed. The dashed tail is the projection.
yield.trajectoryAria: Season yield trajectory with confidence band
yield.byPlotFootnote: Trend compares each plot with its own result last season.

variety.varietyDescription: OM5451 is the workhorse of the Mekong Delta: short-duration, high-yielding, and reliable on alluvial soil. Its long, slender grain has steady export demand, though it needs watching for blast in humid weather.
